title: Decompression technique — A modified approach for lateral alveolar ridge augmentation: A case report
authors: Puisys A, Auzbikaviciute V, Vindasiute-Narbute E, Zukauskas S, Deikuviene J, Razukevicius D. Clin Case Rep. 2021 Jan 3;9(3):1253-1260.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft granules (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Abstract, verbatim (no separate conclusion section): “A particular technique can increase the mucosal and peri-implant bone thickness, prevent compression around implant neck, and obtain proper space for the following prosthetic treatment with an adequate emergence profile.” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
